raw_text: Alternative Work Options: Variations from the standard work schedule.
Full-time Employee: Works a total of 37.5 or 40 hours per week.
Part-time Employee: Works at least half-time, such as 18.75 or 20 hours per week and less than full-time each week.
Job Sharing: Two part-time employees share the responsibility of one full-time position.
Telecommuting: Working at an alternate location (a place which differs from an employee’s primary work location).
Four day work week: Working full-time in four days each week, (also known as a compressed workweek).
Four and one-half day workweek: A full-time work schedule consisting of four extended work days and one day on which the employee works at least 3.5 or 4 hours.
Staggered Schedule: The scheduled arrival and departure times differ from the standard work hours or shift hours.
